verified_properties: normal impact calculation is marked not_requested
emergency and explicit-impact paths preserve calculated results
sensor values, quality and calculation basis are carried into the assistant context
non-finite signal and result values are excluded
main and selected-sensor assistant routes remain isolated
contradictory LLM claims are rejected when they negate confirmed evidence
response evidence source identifiers are carried into the hashed manifest
public HIAD action-to-playbook traceability metadata is carried into the response evidence envelope
public KHK accident-report inventory and citation link are carried into the evidence envelope without mirrored report text
public KHK scenario-precedent map links all 23 citation records to conservative response families without exposing report text or frequency claims
active response families now receive only their integrity-checked KHK public-accident precedents in the runtime evidence manifest, compact LLM prompt and staged operator guidance
consequence flow-boundary mismatches are exposed when HyRAM recomputes a high-pressure choked flow instead of silently presenting it as the supplied process flow
public HIAD action categories are evaluated case-by-case against required staged response plans without using raw action text or making an effectiveness claim
derived HIAD action-category counts and the action-evidence artifact digest are carried into the hashed runtime envelope without raw incident prose
public CC BY accidental-release/ignition archive metadata is carried into the hashed envelope without raw traces, ignition-probability claims or full-loop validation claims
public CC BY sampling-workbook instrumentation context is carried into the evidence envelope without inferring vehicle or receptacle channels

the five-session MetHyTrucks HySaM no-fit tank diagnostic and 244 L versus 77 L geometry sensitivity are carried into all assistant evidence projections with unresolved channel/setup mapping and no prospective or full-loop validation claim
cross-campaign release validation carries one supported, two failed and one ineligible public campaign into every assistant route while prohibiting a universal release-model claim
PRESLHY development and independent holdout outcomes are separated, with failed claim conditions and unchanged runtime parameters preserved
de-identified station-equipment pressure, temperature and state envelope is carried with explicit attestation and full-loop claim limits
channel-indexed measured pressure envelopes are carried as evidence-only context without publishing source tags or applying an unattested bank mapping
owner-attested lifecycle-counter semantics and full-recharge pressure units are carried as history context without enabling an unvalidated degradation model
public real-station back-to-back fueling context and its no-raw-log/full-loop boundary are carried into the evidence envelope
restricted actual-accident metadata is summarized by response-family candidate counts without publishing narratives or treating counts as frequencies
frozen external station-to-vehicle holdout remains explicitly bounded at 0/8, while post-freeze calibration is marked diagnostic-only and cannot support validation claims
public NREL HDVS tank boundary screen is carried with failed pressure screening and a non-promoted geometry diagnostic
public Grune/Sempert ventilation factors are carried into the evidence envelope and applied only to the virtual detector proxy
active releases use the measured upper spatial ventilation envelope by default while median mode remains available for sensitivity analysis
opt-in measured station-boundary pressure scope status is carried in operator frames and evidence envelopes without becoming a safety limit
post-access public capacity/EOS geometry sensitivity is exposed as diagnostic-only evidence while the reference default remains unchanged
runtime evidence preserves reference versus capacity/EOS geometry basis and capacities for each simulation snapshot
public HyTF 70 MPa tank trace is carried as hash-linked component-boundary evidence without a full-loop claim
virtual detector alarm/trip policy is loaded from the public concentration replay record with its claim boundary
virtual detector concentration scale is derived from 22 public concentration traces and carries an explicit open-channel claim boundary
public experimental operating benchmarks are carried into the evidence envelope with pressure-class selection and explicit partial-boundary claim limits
private screen-recording/photo intake is carried as a non-machine-readable provenance boundary without parameter-fit or full-loop authorization

restricted station compressor/cooler thermal evidence is projected into full, summary, header and compact decision contexts as UNCONFIRMED, with no calibration, runtime, vehicle-fill or full-loop claim

public HIAD metadata-to-runtime coverage is projected into full, summary, header and compact decision contexts with 29 direct, four proxy and one response-only cases, while incident narrative parameterization remains prohibited; all nine executable canonical recipes pass

independent KHK metadata-to-runtime traceability is projected into full, summary, header and compact decision contexts: 22 reports covering 25 incident codes traverse eight passing canonical recipes, one KOH-electrolyte release remains outside gaseous-H2 scope, and report narrative parameterization remains prohibited

operator effectiveness, omission rate or unsafe-advice rate
response effectiveness or operator benefit from HIAD metadata coverage

public_incident_traceability.interpretation: qualitative scenario-family and action-to-playbook traceability only; excludes HIAD response text and does not establish effectiveness or safety

digital_twin_replay.interpretation: canonical family runtime traceability only; no accident reconstruction, safe-distance or response-effectiveness claim

accident_response_coverage_evaluation.interpretation: public accident action-category to staged-plan interface coverage only; cases without a recorded category are not treated as having no response

confidential_local_accident_response_cov.interpretation: metadata candidate-family coverage only; counts are not incident frequencies because cases may map to multiple families

runtime_public_accident_precedent_routin.interpretation: scenario-specific citation routing and prompt-delivery integrity only; it does not establish response correctness, causality, frequency, operator benefit or safety

response_stage_contract.interpretation: interface-stage coverage only; no correctness, safety, effectiveness, physics or operator-benefit claim

public_accident_report_grounding.interpretation: qualitative actual-accident scenario and response/prevention grounding only; map uses public equipment classes/titles and citation links, not report text, frequencies, causal inference or physics-validation claims

digital_twin_replay.interpretation: independent metadata-to-canonical-runtime traceability only; no accident reconstruction, physics validation, safe-distance, frequency or response-effectiveness claim

runtime_action_taxonomy.interpretation: compact public-incident grounding metadata only; no correctness, safety, effectiveness or probability claim

public_accidental_release_evidence.interpretation: public accidental-release/ignition provenance and qualitative scenario grounding only; no ignition probability or station full-loop claim

public_measurement_instrumentation.interpretation: public measurement timing and instrumentation context only; no vehicle-channel inference or full-loop validation claim

methytrucks_tank_diagnostic_boundary.interpretation: post-access no-fit component diagnostic only; the assistant receives the observed error and geometry sensitivity but cannot describe them as independent, prospective, full-loop, certified or field-safety validation

cross_campaign_release_validation_bounda.interpretation: Mixed endpoint and apparatus evidence only. One passing public transient does not override two failed campaigns or an ineligible pressure-decay candidate; universal release, station, consequence-distance and field-safety validation remain unsupported.

public_tank_validation_boundary.interpretation: partial tank/thermal boundary evidence only; geometry ratio is diagnostic and is not applied as a production correction or full-loop validation claim

preslhy_validation_boundary.interpretation: development and independent holdout are kept separate; no validated release claim is made

confidential_station_equipment_operation.interpretation: privacy-bounded station equipment context only; no vehicle or full-loop claim

confidential_pressure_channel_envelopes.interpretation: de-identified channel-indexed station-boundary context only; no bank identity, vehicle-side accuracy or full-loop validation claim

closed_loop_validation_boundary.interpretation: predeclared full-loop pressure, temperature and final-SOC screens failed on all 8 external cases; later calibration is retained only to diagnose premature thermal stopping and under-delivery

public_grune_ventilation_evidence.claim_limit: not CFD, not detector certification, not outdoor HRS or full-loop validation

public_geometry_sensitivity.interpretation: post-access sensitivity only; capacity/EOS remains explicit opt-in and requires a frozen prospective external holdout before any default change

public_tank_trace_boundary.interpretation: hash-linked public tank boundary candidate; component screening only until a separately frozen protocol is run

public_operating_benchmarks.pressure_class_selection: 35 MPa FCH2RAIL context below 50 MPa; H70 NREL context above 50 MPa
public_operating_benchmarks.interpretation: These are aggregate public experimental benchmarks and a separately controlled tank/hose trace. They provide real operating-range context and partial-boundary evidence; they do not establish complete station-to-vehicle digital-twin accuracy, accident frequency, safety distance, or field certification.

confidential_station_thermal_dynamics_bo.interpretation: pending generic channel-role and engineering-unit custodian attestation; no measurement rows or source identifiers are exposed to the assistant
